jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # minor versions only, so each run picks up the latest patch release
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.13", "3.14"]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install uv and set the python version
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

    - name: Set up python
      run: uv python install

    # --upgrade ignores the pins in uv.lock and resolves the newest versions
    # allowed by pyproject.toml, so that breakage from a new release of a
    # dependency shows up here rather than in users' environments
    - name: Install the project with the latest dependencies
      run: uv sync --dev --upgrade

    - name: Show resolved dependency versions
      run: uv pip list

    # numba compiles FastRiskScore's and FastSmallTree's search on first use (about 3.5 min);
    # cache the compiled code between runs. numba checks each source file's mtime, and a
    # fresh checkout sets it to now, so pin the mtimes first or the cache would never be used.
    - name: Pin source mtimes for the numba cache
      run: find imodels -name '*.py' -exec touch -d '2020-01-01 00:00:00' {} +

    - name: Cache numba-compiled code
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: |
          imodels/**/__pycache__/*.nbi
          imodels/**/__pycache__/*.nbc
        key: numba-${{ runner.os }}-py${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('imodels/algebraic/risk_score/solver.py', 'imodels/tree/optimal_tree/solver.py') }}
        restore-keys: numba-${{ runner.os }}-py${{ matrix.python-version }}-

    # pytest-xdist: one worker per CPU
    - name: Run tests
      run: uv run pytest -n auto tests

requires = ["setuptools>=77", "wheel"]  # 77: PEP 639 license / license-files
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "imodels"
version = "3.0.4"
description = "Implementations of various interpretable models"
readme = "readme.md"
requires-python = ">=3.9"
license = "MIT"
license-files = ["license.md"]  # lowercase, so the default LICEN[CS]E* glob misses it
authors = [
  { name = "Chandan Singh", email = "csinva23@gmail.com" },
  { name = "Keyan Nasseri" },
  { name = "Matthew Epland" },
  { name = "Yan Shuo Tan" },
  { name = "Omer Ronen" },
  { name = "Tiffany Tang" },
  { name = "Abhineet Agarwal" },
  { name = "Theo Saarinen" },
  { name = "Bin Yu", email = "binyu@berkeley.edu" }
]
classifiers = [
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Operating System :: OS Independent",
]
dependencies = [
  "matplotlib",
  "mlxtend",        # some lower versions are missing fpgrowth
  "numpy",
  "pandas",
  "requests",               # used in c4.5
  "scipy",
  "scikit-learn",     # 1.6.0 has issue with ensemble models
  "tqdm"                    # used in BART
]
[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/csinva/imodels"
Repository = "https://github.com/csinva/imodels"


[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
include = ["imodels*"]
exclude = ["notebooks*", "tests*", "docs*"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
"imodels.viz" = ["assets/*"]  # page templates, styles and scripts for imodels.viz.interactive

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "jupyter>=1.1.1",
    "jupytext",
    "pdoc3",
    "pytest",
    "pytest-cov",
    "slurmpy",
    "pmlb",
    "dvu",
    "gdown",
    "numba>=0.60",
    "pytest-xdist>=3.8.0",
]

# Optional algorithm deps mentioned in setup.py comments
[project.optional-dependencies]
optional = [
  "cvxpy", # for slim
  "statsmodels", # for bartpy
  "torch", # for imodels.util.neural_nets
  "interpret", # for imodels.algebraic.gam_multitask
  "numba>=0.60", # for imodels.tree.optimal_tree
  "glmnet", # for imodels.tree.rf_plus.rf_plus; this is deprecated - should remove
  "cairosvg", # for saving imodels.viz figures as .png / .pdf
]
